explanation: This is zero at every D1 and GO step, and nonzero only at D2 on trials where the agent chose a1, and only early in the episode: about 5-10 (often 8-10) from roughly trial 3 to trial 13, fading to about 1-4 by trials 14-20 and to 0 after about trial 20. It doesnt depend on whether the transition was common or rare or on the reward, and it is always 0 on trials where the agent chose a2.
